# Module `legal` of graph `example_graph`

Prefix `leg`, version 1.0.0. The legal entities of the group and who owns whom, and which entity employs people or runs units; not the internal structure of the company (organization) or the people (people).

Ontology `company` 1.1.0. The live source is `graph describe module legal --graph example_graph --json`; it wins when they differ. Fields, states and relations of a type: `graph describe type <type> --graph example_graph --json`.
